_readme: Recorded command outputs for the platforms the fake fleet cannot containerise (plan.md S0-8). Formats follow what each manager's parser documents; these are representative fixtures, not captures from live AIX/Solaris/HP-UX/Windows hardware. Commands not listed here replay as rc=0 with empty output.
